title: Batch Manifest
description: Per-batch frozen manifest. This is the SOLE byte stream from which manifest_hash is derived (scheme v12 §1.2). It is generated BEFORE any randomization/assignment is drawn and excludes ALL runtime fields (assignment results, seeds, timestamps). WARNING: JSON Schema validates SHAPE ONLY. The byte-exact canonicalization contract — RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization, NFC-first on every string, the canonical decimal-string grammar for non-integers, uniqueItems checked AFTER NFC, cities dedup on (city,date) AFTER NFC, and the manifest_hash / seed_assign formulas — lives in CONTRACT-NOTES.md and MUST be enforced by the runner. Passing this schema is necessary but NOT sufficient. The SHA256 of THIS schema file plus schema_version are frozen into the lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. Byte-exact rules that JSON Schema cannot express are in CONTRACT-NOTES.md — read it before implementing the manifest builder.

prompt_min_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the raw bytes of prompt-v5-min.txt (P-min), file bytes as-is (scheme §1.2, §9).

prompt_q_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the raw bytes of prompt-v5-q.txt (P-q = P-min + fixed_suffix; byte assertion q_bytes == min_bytes + fixed_suffix per §9).

snapshot_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the frozen weather snapshot (canary values, e.g. max 27.4/min 13.9/code 61; expected-value table persisted with extractor version). See weather-snapshot.json (scheme §1.2).

cities.description: Measurement fixture cities. Element shape fixed to {city,date,lat,lon}. Persisted SORT ORDER = byte order of each element's canonical JSON (JCS) — NOT expressible here; runner MUST sort. Duplicate (city,date) rejected AFTER NFC (see CONTRACT-NOTES). uniqueItems here only catches whole-item exact dupes.

city.description: City name string. NFC-normalized before hashing (runner-enforced).

date.description: UTC calendar date (ISO 8601 date). harness always passes ?date= explicitly in UTC (scheme §1.2).

lat.description: Latitude as a canonical decimal STRING (no exponent / no leading + / no leading zero except 0.x / no trailing decimal zero / no -0). Represented as string to keep the manifest byte stream fully controlled rather than relying on JCS number formatting. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme mandates decimal strings for NON-integers and is silent on integer-valued coordinates; this contract requires ALL coordinates to be canonical decimal strings for type stability (an integer coordinate serializes as e.g. "52", the grammar's no-fraction form). See CONTRACT-NOTES.

lon.description: Longitude as a canonical decimal STRING. Same grammar and same JUDGMENT-CALL note as lat.

config_ids.description: Config identifiers. Persisted SORT ORDER = NFC UTF-8 byte order, fixed at BUILD time; every downstream use site (config/block traversal, pooled PRNG sampling map, mask iteration) MUST take this persisted array order verbatim and is FORBIDDEN from re-sorting by any local collation (scheme §1.2 v12 config-order rule). Duplicates rejected AFTER NFC (uniqueItems here only catches exact-string dupes).

N.description: Slots per config per variant, frozen batch-wide before any assignment draw (scheme §1.1 min 3, target 5; §1.2 batch-uniform N).

env_digest.description: Digest of the pinned render environment (Chromium version, fonts, flags, image libs — appendix A). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme names the field but not its exact construction; contract fixes it as a lowercase-hex SHA256 over the canonical env descriptor. Exact input bytes to be pinned in CONTRACT-NOTES / appendix A follow-up.

pipeline_commit.description: Git commit of the pipeline. Working tree MUST be clean — a dirty tree rejects the whole batch, there is NO source_digest fallback (scheme §1.2). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): pattern assumes 40-hex SHA-1 git; a SHA-256 git repo would need 64-hex — widen the pattern if the repo migrates.
